svg.text: Realised chunk size is not the size you asked for
Median tokens actually landing in a chunk, by chunker kind and nominal budget. Leg A / TREC CDS pilot corpus (4,053 articles,
median 4,532 tokens); hollow markers repeat the measurement on the Leg B PMC OA corpus (400 articles). SFR-Embedding-Mistral
tokenizer. Census of every chunk - no sampling error, no error bars needed.
A: a 2,048-token budget yields 2,048 realised tokens under token_window, 1,977 under sentence, 1,307 under words and 343 under semantic - semantic's
'size' is a cap that never binds, so all four semantic cells are ~350-token configs wearing four different labels. B: fill is a property of corpus x
kind, not of kind: scifact's decay to 17% is a document-length artefact (a 348-token document cannot fill a 2,048-token budget) and does not transfer
